title: Juniper and the Harvest
author: Ada Ishikawa
blurb: Oscar Ravensworth, a hospice nurse who hears the dying count backwards, has spent three years telling themselves the noises have explanations. Then the village's church bell rings although the bell was melted down in 1911 — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. Now they must get the family out ahead of the count, and time is already running out.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
